notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Video Analyzer extracts shot list: cut timing, lens focal length & depth of field, lighting setup, framing, motion vectors, color LUT → Structured Camera Memory (JSON shot-by-shot spec) → Creative Director maps each reference shot onto the wireless headphones's own story beats → Nano Banana Pro generates matching first-frame keyframe per shot (product swapped in, composition/lighting matched to source) → Omni Flash 1.1 animates each keyframe using the extracted camera-move + timing spec → Continuity Validator checks product consistency + camera-language fidelity across shots → Repair on drifted shots → Video Concat stitches final sequence → Color grade LUT applied to match reference → Package.
STAGE 1 — INGESTION The reference film plus one photo of the Wireless Headphones that will replace its subject.

STAGE 2 — STRUCTURED CAMERA MEMORY Cut timing, camera path, lens, lighting, motion vectors and LUT become a shot-by-shot JSON spec, then each reference shot is mapped onto this product's own story beats.
STAGE 3 — KEYFRAME + MOTION EXECUTION Nano Banana Pro builds the matching first frame per shot with the product swapped in; Omni Flash 1.1 executes the extracted camera move.
STAGE 4 — CONTINUITY VALIDATOR + REPAIR Camera-move trajectory and cut timing compared against the extracted spec; product-lock checked across every shot.
STAGE 5 — CONCAT + LUT GRADE MATCH Shots stitched in order, then a grade pass matches the reference LUT.

M-VT0038_Baby_Stroller___Style_Transfer_.title: VT0038. Baby Stroller — Style Transfer Pass Pipeline (#8)

M-VT0038_Baby_Stroller___Style_Transfer_.pipeline: reference-image-input → video-input → 4× text-gen → 3× image-gen → 3× upscaler → video-edit → 3× text-gen → image-gen → download
notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Source Forensics assesses resolution, lighting flatness, style gap vs brand target → Enhancement Director configures a Style Transfer Pass pass, which translates a real scene into a reference aesthetic (watercolor, claymation, ink wash, anime, halftone print) while preserving subject identity and composition → Nano Banana Pro applies the enhancement to keyframes → Omni Flash 1.1 video-to-video re-renders the full clip carrying the enhancement through every frame with temporal consistency → Fidelity Critic (has identity/branding survived the enhancement, or has it drifted into a different product?) → Repair on drift → Package at delivery resolution (1080p/4K).
STAGE 1 — INGESTION The existing low-res, flat-lit or off-brand asset — still, footage, or both.
STAGE 2 — SOURCE FORENSICS Assesses resolution, lighting flatness and the style gap against the brand target.
STAGE 3 — ENHANCEMENT DIRECTOR Configures the Style Transfer Pass pass, which translates a real scene into a reference aesthet pass. The rule: a better capture of the SAME subject, never a redesign.
STAGE 4 — VIDEO-TO-VIDEO RE-RENDER Omni Flash 1.1 carries the enhancement through every frame with temporal consistency.
STAGE 5 — FIDELITY CRITIC + REPAIR Has identity survived the enhancement, or has it drifted into a different product? Drift triggers a lower-strength re-pass.

requires.name: Hiking Backpack — anchor image (if the mode uses one)
Source video (if the mode edits one)

notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Ingestion → Mode Router selects 'Scene Extension in Increments': extend a video's duration in 3-10 second increments up to a 30-second total, maintaining continuity from the existing final frames → Input Prep (Nano Banana Pro pre-cleans or generates any needed reference/anchor images) → Omni Flash 1.1 executes the mode's native generation/edit call with correctly structured inputs (frameImages / referenceImages / source video as required) → World-Knowledge Consistency Critic (does the result respect physics, scene logic, and the world-knowledge grounding Omni Flash brings beyond raw photorealism?) → Repair via a follow-up Interactions-API turn (conversational edit) rather than a full regeneration when the mode supports it → Deliver at draft (360p) then promote to 1080p/4K once approved → Package.
STAGE 1 — MODE ROUTER + INPUT PREP Mode: Scene Extension in Increments. Wire only the inputs this mode actually consumes — text brief, one anchor image, up to five references, or an existing clip.
STAGE 2 — INPUT PREP (NANO BANANA PRO) Pre-cleans or generates any anchor and reference frames the mode requires.
STAGE 3 — OMNI FLASH 1.1 EXECUTION The mode's native call. The text-only lane uses a prompt-only video-gen node; the reference lane conditions on the anchor; the edit lane consumes the source video.

STAGE 4 — WORLD-KNOWLEDGE CONSISTENCY CRITIC Does the result respect physics, scene logic and the world knowledge Omni Flash brings beyond raw photorealism? Repair via a follow-up edit turn, not a full regeneration.
STAGE 5 — DRAFT THEN PROMOTE Review at draft resolution, then promote the approved cut to delivery.

M-VT0499_Autonomous_Trend_Detection___Ra.summary: TREND SCANNER No trend is given — the system finds one.

requires.name: Autonomous Trend-Detection & Rapid-Response Pipeline — product from the library

notes: PIPELINE (from the library spec) Trend Scanner searches current social platforms for rising formats (view velocity, repost/like ratio as an early-signal proxy) → Brand-Fit Reasoner screens each candidate trend against brand tone/values (discard trends that are off-brand or reputationally risky) → Format Extractor breaks the winning trend into its exact structural beats and documented failure modes → Adaptation Director maps a brand product into those beats → Nano Banana Pro + Omni Flash 1.1 produce the piece → Trend-Fidelity + Brand-Fit dual critic → Repair → Same-day Export → Alert delivered to the marketing team with a recommended posting window while the trend is still rising, not after it peaks.
STAGE 1 — TREND SCANNER No trend is given — the system finds one. The scrape lane stands in for the platform scan: a rising-format query, scraped and randomised each run.
STAGE 2 — BRAND-FIT REASONER + FORMAT EXTRACTOR Screens each candidate against brand tone and risk, then breaks the winner into its exact structural beats and documented failure modes.
STAGE 3 — ADAPTATION DIRECTOR + PRODUCTION The brand product is mapped into the extracted beats and produced.
STAGE 4 — DUAL CRITIC + SAME-DAY EXPORT Trend fidelity and brand fit scored together, then exported for the recommended posting window.
